title: Central Transport reaches $5.5M settlement with EEOC for allegedly refusing to hire women drivers
summary: The carrier allegedly selected less qualified male applicants and subjected women who applied to jobs to separate hiring procedures.

title: White broadcaster lawfully fired for on-air Snoop Dogg quote, racial slur, court says
summary: Termination for such conduct is lawful even when a plaintiff argues that the offensiveness is “wrongly concluded,” the court wrote.

title: Buc-ee’s allegedly treated worker with a disability with ‘reckless indifference’
summary: “Inflexible thinking” can cause employers to run afoul of reasonable accommodation requirements, an acting regional attorney for the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission said.

title: EEOC chair says Trump admin is ‘widening’ civil rights aperture
summary: Andrea Lucas also addressed her previous social media call for White men to bring discrimination claims at the Fortune Workplace Innovation Summit.

title: Workers say values matter — but only when a company lives them
summary: Nearly half of employees say they have worked for companies that didn’t live up to the principles they said they embraced.

title: Leaders and employees disagree about AI workflow readiness
summary: A growing gap exists between what organizational leaders expect artificial intelligence to deliver and what their companies are currently able to do, Adecco Group said.

title: Edward Jones allegedly paid Black financial advisers less than their White peers
summary: One employee involved in a race discrimination lawsuit against the company also said she was told to use “a more race-neutral name” during an interview.

title: AI certifications are fast-tracking salary and career growth, Randstad finds
summary: While layoffs dominate the news and most workers languish, another market exists for AI skills, where workers are in high demand and compensation soars.

title: In 2026, more HR leaders are focused on training — and not just for AI skills
summary: A shifting job market and desire for better workforce management may be why more HR pros considered learning a top priority this year, experts said.

title: Why inclusion should be baked into AI adoption
summary: An artificial intelligence inclusion framework from talent advisory firm Seramount puts the spotlight on how AI initiatives can leave certain groups behind.
